label: airFiber 3X
description: 3 GHz airFiber X carrier backhaul radio (antenna sold separately, AF-3G26-S45). Up to 687 Mbps real throughput, 200+ km range, GPS-synchronised for co-location, 24 V passive PoE in. Ports: 1x GbE data RJ45 + 1x 10/100 MbE management RJ45, plus RP-SMA RF and GPS antenna connectors.
